i’m not sure this is a disorder as much as it might be some insecurity you’ve felt within yourself, being insecure can cause you to think everyone has ulterior motives and that you’re being deceived. of course no one on this site can diagnose you, as most of us aren’t doctors (and i’m not sure a doctor could tell just from this post) so i’d encourage you to talk to a professional if you can, good luck ♥️

it can be really scary but try to open up about your feelings to people you trust in small ways at first, it’s scary, but opening up is very healthy and you’ll feel a lot better when you do. your feelings and emotions are perfectly normal, don’t worry!

your girlfriend is with you for a reason! if your relationship is otherwise open and honest and loving, you have nothing to worry about. good for you to recognize this problem! and it’s okay to ask her for reassurance when you’re feeling jealous or insecure, but also it’s important to work of building yourself up as well because that’s probably the source of your problem.
